verdict.rationale: Bento's own CLI can do anything the dashboard can, including reading runs, signals and analytics, and it emits plain JSON that can be piped to a file. Skills and rules also live in the user's repo as Markdown and YAML, so that accumulated knowledge is portable by design. However, there is no documented bulk or full-account export of traces and history, and no offboarding or leave path is described; OpenTelemetry is documented only for ingestion. missing for 10: a documented complete data export (traces, issues, signals, history) in open formats, an explicit offboarding/data-portability guarantee, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI: triage issues, read runs, inspect signals, pull analytics.
